subject: maths
question: If sin m + sin n = p, cos m + cos n = q, then find the value of sin m × sin n + cos m × cos n.
solution:
**Given:**

sin m + sin n = p

cos m + cos n = q

**Concept Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

sin m + sin n = p

Square both sides

(sin m + sin n)² = p²

1 - cos2 m + 1 - cos2 n + 2 × sin m × sin n = p² ................(i)

cos m + cos n = q

Square both sides

cos2 m + cos2 n + 2 × cos m × cos n = q2................(ii)

Add equation (i) and (ii)

2 + 2 × sin m × sin n + 2 × cos m × cos n = q² + p2

2(sin m × sin n + cos m × cos n) = q2 + p² - 2

sin m × sin n + cos m × cos n = (q2 + p2 - 2)/2

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
